def generate_token(length=30, chars=UNICODE_ASCII_CHARACTER_SET):
    """Generate a random token string.
    
    Args:
        length: The desired length of the token (default: 30)
        chars: The character set to use for generating the token (default: UNICODE_ASCII_CHARACTER_SET)
    
    Returns:
        A random string of the specified length using characters from the specified set
    """
    rng = SystemRandom()
    return ''.join(rng.choice(chars) for _ in range(length))
